## Overview

| Item | Details |
|------|---------|
| **Input** | DESeq2-style contrast table: `Gene`, `Comparison`, `log2FoldChange`, `padj`, optional `stat` |
| **Key packages** | `decoupleR`, `OmnipathR`, `CARNIVAL`, `igraph`, `ggplot2`, `pheatmap` |
| **Statistics** | TF activity score from signed TF-target regulons; PKN overlap; recurrent causal edges; module target coverage |
| **Output** | TF volcano/heatmap, TF-to-PKN diagnostics, recurrent-edge overview, module-specific causal networks, Cytoscape-ready exports |
| **Download** | [template.Rmd](template.Rmd) |

Edit the `## ── USER CONFIGURATION` block at the top of `template.Rmd`. The gallery demo uses
synthetic DE results and cached toy CARNIVAL-like networks. For real analyses, point `DEG_FILE`
to your DESeq2 contrast table, set `RUN_CARNIVAL_SOLVER <- TRUE` only after installing a solver,
and keep `USE_CACHED_CARNIVAL_RESULTS <- TRUE` for reproducible re-renders.
